insert.column: WITH scope AS ( SELECT ounder.id AS office_id FROM m_office o JOIN m_office ounder ON ounder.hierarchy LIKE CONCAT(o.hierarchy, '%') WHERE o.id = ${officeId} AND ounder.hierarchy LIKE CONCAT('${currentUserHierarchy}', '%') ), latest AS ( SELECT h.* FROM ( SELECT l.id, l.client_id, l.office_id, l.account_no, l.product_id, l.loan_officer_id, l.loan_status_id, l.generic_loan_counter, l.approvedon_date, l.disbursedon_date, l.closedon_date, l.term_frequency, l.term_period_frequency_enum, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY l.client_id ORDER BY l.disbursedon_date DESC, l.id DESC) AS rn FROM m_loan l WHERE l.client_id IS NOT NULL AND l.disbursedon_date IS NOT NULL AND l.loan_status_id NOT IN (100, 200, 400, 500) ) h WHERE h.rn = 1 ), elig AS ( SELECT lt.* FROM latest lt JOIN m_client c ON c.id = lt.client_id WHERE lt.loan_status_id IN (600, 700) AND ('${latestLoanStatusId}' = '-1' OR lt.loan_status_id = '${latestLoanStatusId}') AND IFNULL(lt.generic_loan_counter, 0) >= CAST('${minLoanCycle}' AS SIGNED) AND c.status_enum IN (300, 303, 304) AND COALESCE(lt.office_id, c.office_id) IN (SELECT office_id FROM scope) AND ('${loanOfficerId}' = '-1' OR IFNULL(lt.loan_officer_id, -10) = '${loanOfficerId}') AND ('${loanProductId}' = '-1' OR lt.product_id = '${loanProductId}') AND ('${excludeActiveLoans}' <> '1' OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM m_loan a WHERE a.client_id = lt.client_id AND a.loan_status_id IN (300, 303, 304))) AND ('${excludePendingApplications}' <> '1' OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM m_loan a WHERE a.client_id = lt.client_id AND a.loan_status_id IN (100, 200))) ), po AS ( SELECT t.loan_id, MAX(t.transaction_date) AS last_paid_on FROM m_loan_transaction t JOIN elig e ON e.id = t.loan_id WHERE t.is_reversed = 0 AND t.transaction_type_enum IN (2, 5, 6, 8, 28) AND COALESCE(t.principal_portion_derived, 0) + COALESCE(t.interest_portion_derived, 0) + COALESCE(t.fee_charges_portion_derived, 0) + COALESCE(t.penalty_charges_portion_derived, 0) > 0 GROUP BY t.loan_id ), dated AS ( SELECT e.*, COALESCE(po.last_paid_on, e.closedon_date) AS payoff_date, CASE e.term_period_frequency_enum WHEN 0 THEN DATE_ADD(e.disbursedon_date, INTERVAL e.term_frequency DAY) WHEN 1 THEN DATE_ADD(e.disbursedon_date, INTERVAL e.term_frequency WEEK) WHEN 2 THEN DATE_ADD(e.disbursedon_date, INTERVAL e.term_frequency MONTH) WHEN 3 THEN DATE_ADD(e.disbursedon_date, INTERVAL e.term_frequency YEAR) WHEN 6 THEN DATE_ADD(e.disbursedon_date, INTERVAL e.term_frequency * 28 DAY) END AS term_end FROM elig e LEFT JOIN po ON po.loan_id = e.id ), aged AS ( SELECT d.*, CASE WHEN d.term_period_frequency_enum = 2 THEN d.term_frequency ELSE TIMESTAMPDIFF(MONTH, d.disbursedon_date, d.term_end) + (DATE_ADD(d.disbursedon_date, INTERVAL TIMESTAMPDIFF(MONTH, d.disbursedon_date, d.term_end) MONTH) < d.term_end) END AS term_months, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MONTH, d.disbursedon_date, d.payoff_date) + (DATE_ADD(d.disbursedon_date, INTERVAL TIMESTAMPDIFF(MONTH, d.disbursedon_date, d.payoff_date) MONTH) < d.payoff_date) AS age_months FROM dated d ), banded AS ( SELECT DISTINCT a.*, a.age_months - a.term_months AS months_late, CASE WHEN a.age_months - a.term_months IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN a.age_months - a.term_months <= 0 THEN 1 WHEN a.age_months - a.term_months <= 3 THEN 2 WHEN a.age_months - a.term_months <= 6 THEN 3 ELSE 4 END AS band_id FROM aged a ), adr AS ( SELECT z.client_id, z.country_id, z.state_province_id FROM ( SELECT ca.client_id, ad.country_id, ad.state_province_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ca.client_id ORDER BY ca.is_active DESC, ad.id DESC) AS rn FROM m_client_address ca JOIN m_address ad ON ad.id = ca.address_id JOIN banded b ON b.client_id = ca.client_id ) z WHERE z.rn = 1 ), coi AS ( SELECT z.client_id, z.strata_cv_id, z.telephone_no FROM ( SELECT x.client_id, x.strata_cv_id, x.telephone_no, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY x.client_id ORDER BY x.id DESC) AS rn FROM m_client_other_info x JOIN banded b ON b.client_id = x.client_id ) z WHERE z.rn = 1 ), crs AS ( SELECT z.client_id, z.survey_location_cv_id FROM ( SELECT x.client_id, x.survey_location_cv_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY x.client_id ORDER BY x.id DESC) AS rn FROM m_client_recruitment_survey x JOIN banded b ON b.client_id = x.client_id ) z WHERE z.rn = 1 ), done AS ( SELECT l.client_id, COUNT(*) AS completed_loans FROM m_loan l JOIN banded b ON b.client_id = l.client_id WHERE l.disbursedon_date IS NOT NULL AND l.loan_status_id IN (600, 601, 700) GROUP BY l.client_id ) SELECT c.id AS 'Client ID', st.display_name AS 'Loan Officer', cvco.code_value AS 'Country', cvrg.code_value AS 'Region', cvst.code_value AS 'Strata', cvlo.code_value AS 'Location', c.display_name AS 'Client Name', COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(coi.telephone_no), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(c.mobile_no), '')) AS 'Client Contact Phone Number', b.id AS 'Most Recent Loan ID', b.account_no AS 'Most Recent Loan Number', p.name AS 'Most Recent Loan Product', b.disbursedon_date AS 'Most Recent Loan Start Date', b.approvedon_date AS 'Most Recent Loan Approval Date', b.disbursedon_date AS 'Most Recent Loan Disbursement Date', b.payoff_date AS 'Most Recent Loan Pay-Off Date', CASE b.loan_status_id WHEN 600 THEN 'Closed (obligations met)' WHEN 700 THEN 'Overpaid' END AS 'Most Recent Loan Status', b.generic_loan_counter AS 'Most Recent Loan Cycle', IFNULL(done.completed_loans, 0) AS 'Completed Loans to Date', b.term_months AS 'Approved Loan Term (Months)', b.age_months AS 'Actual Loan Age at Pay-Off (Months)', b.months_late AS 'Months Early/Late', CASE b.band_id WHEN 1 THEN 'ONTIME' WHEN 2 THEN 'SLOW' WHEN 3 THEN 'MODLATE' WHEN 4 THEN 'OVERLATE' END AS 'Paid-Off Performance Band' FROM banded b JOIN m_client c ON c.id = b.client_id LEFT JOIN adr ON adr.client_id = b.client_id LEFT JOIN coi ON coi.client_id = b.client_id LEFT JOIN crs ON crs.client_id = b.client_id LEFT JOIN done ON done.client_id = b.client_id LEFT JOIN m_product_loan p ON p.id = b.product_id LEFT JOIN m_staff st ON st.id = b.loan_officer_id LEFT JOIN m_code_value cvco ON cvco.id = adr.country_id LEFT JOIN m_code_value cvrg ON cvrg.id = adr.state_province_id LEFT JOIN m_code_value cvst ON cvst.id = coi.strata_cv_id LEFT JOIN m_code_value cvlo ON cvlo.id = crs.survey_location_cv_id WHERE ('${countryId}' = '-1' OR IFNULL(adr.country_id, -10) = '${countryId}') AND ('${regionId}' = '-1' OR IFNULL(adr.state_province_id, -10) = '${regionId}') AND ('${strataId}' = '-1' OR IFNULL(coi.strata_cv_id, -10) = '${strataId}') AND ('${locationId}' = '-1' OR IFNULL(crs.survey_location_cv_id, -10) = '${locationId}') AND ('${paidOffBandId}' = '-1' OR b.band_id = '${paidOffBandId}') AND b.payoff_date >= '${startDate}' AND b.payoff_date <= '${endDate}' ORDER BY c.id LIMIT ${limit} OFFSET ${offset}
